overview: This 116-page file documents Japanese merchant shipping in 1938–39 through consular reports, correspondence, press clippings, and translated laws. It covers shipbuilding, shipping policy and finance, a U.S. investigation of Japanese coffee freight rates, proposed services, and the consolidation of Japan–China coastal shipping.
interest: Translated shipping laws and contemporary reports reveal how state support, commercial competition, and coastal consolidation shaped Japan’s maritime industry.
